name: Octocrawl
tagline: Read web pages as Markdown or JSON, with an Evidence Record for every answer
description:
Octocrawl reads the web for agents. `scrape` returns a page as Markdown, JSON, links or HTML, and `map` lists a site's URLs. Every answer carries an Evidence Record: the final URL, HTTP status, robots.txt decision and hashes of what was read. A page that is blocked, empty or not the page asked for comes back as such, with the reason, instead of as made-up content.

This entry connects to hosted Octocrawl: no account or API key, 20 pages a day per address, reset at 00:00 UTC. The same open-source server runs on your own computer with every tool (crawl, batch scrape, saved logins, Monitor) and no daily limit; see the setup page.

install.notes: No key is needed. A key (a higher daily allowance and, when the key allows it, the browser lane) goes in an Authorization: Bearer header. To run every tool locally with no daily limit, start `npx octocrawl serve` (Node.js 22.13+) and install the stdio server instead: `cline mcp install octocrawl -- npx -y @octocrawl/mcp`.
